title: Multiplying Fractions — worked example

body.title: Multiplying Fractions — worked example
body.hook: We'll learn multiplying fractions by studying one clear example first.

steps: Watch out: Multiplies fractions by adding instead

body.misconception_check: Avoid this trap: Multiplies fractions by adding instead

prompt:
You are a Year 5 maths tutor. Teach using WORKED EXAMPLE FIRST.

Skill: multiplying fractions
Active misconception to address: Multiplies fractions by adding instead
Teaching method: worked_example

Rules:
- Show one fully worked example step by step BEFORE any practice.
- Explicitly warn against this misconception: Multiplies fractions by adding instead
- Then give 3 short practice questions.
- You MUST use these exact correct answers (do not invent different answers):
- example mul_01: 1/6
- mul_02: 1/5
- mul_03: 1/2
- mul_04: 1/6

Return JSON only with this shape:
{
  "title": "...",
  "method": "worked_example",
  "hook": "one sentence",
  "worked_example": {"problem": "...", "steps": ["..."], "answer": "..."},
  "misconception_check": "one sentence correcting the misconception",
  "practice": [{"id": "...", "prompt": "...", "answer": "..."}],
  "exit_ticket": {"prompt": "...", "answer": "..."}
}

Practice stems (use these; keep their answers exactly):
- id=mul_02 | Calculate 2/5 × 1/2. | CORRECT_ANSWER=1/5
- id=mul_03 | Calculate 3/4 × 2/3. | CORRECT_ANSWER=1/2
- id=mul_04 | What is 1/4 of 2/3? (Same as 1/4 × 2/3.) | CORRECT_ANSWER=1/6
